instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the bearded man in a black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right. The woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing left. She leans forward and extends her left arm to touch the bearded man's (R1) upper arm. The scene is illuminated by overhead artificial lights, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
